summary: Build practical data mesh skills in governance, data products, and architecture design. Learn through workshops, templates, and roadmap exercises.
lede: Data mesh training covers domain-aligned architecture, data products, and federated governance. For professionals shaping data architecture, platforms, governance, or analytics delivery, it provides practical work in mapping domain boundaries, assigning product ownership, and defining data contracts. You also practice governance and quality controls, compare lakehouse and distributed warehouse patterns, and create architecture sketches and data product inventories.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape data architecture, governance, platform strategy, and analytics delivery across business domains.
prerequisites: Participants should have a working knowledge of data architecture, data warehousing, SQL concepts, and enterprise data governance. Prior exposure to cloud data platforms, metadata concepts, or analytics delivery is helpful. Coding is not required for completion, although familiarity with data modeling or basic scripting will make the exercises easier to follow. The course is designed at an intermediate level, so you should be ready to work with architectural diagrams, ownership models, and governance artifacts during the training.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
